charts.title: Kepler-367 b: orbits around Kepler-367
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-367's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-367 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Gajdoš et al. 2019 (2019RAA....19...41G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GAJDO_SCARON__ET_AL__2019): P 37.8164765958 d
